_comment: Social reactions (M16b, A45; P2/Q5). How the town reacts to a *visible* change. `when_tags` match subject part/attr tags; `valence` sign pulls the bond; `familiarity_key` is what a familiarity taper wears off (A23). A strong bond notices more and a household reacts first. All data.

reactions.label: the tail
lines: {observer} clocks the tail and cannot stop glancing at it
{observer} asks whether {subject} can actually move it
{observer} reaches out to touch {subject}'s tail, then thinks better of it

reactions.label: the ears
lines: {observer} keeps staring at {subject}'s ears like they might twitch
"those are new," {observer} says, meaning the ears

reactions.label: the coat
lines: {observer} says the fur suits {subject} and means it
{observer} reaches for {subject}'s sleeve and finds fur
{observer} wonders aloud if {subject} sheds

reactions.label: the teeth
lines: {observer} watches {subject} smile and does a double take at the teeth
"say that again?" {observer} asks, of the fangs

reactions.label: the hands
lines: {observer} notices {subject} fumble a cup and hides a wince
{observer} asks how {subject} types, now

reactions.label: the claws
lines: {observer} watches {subject} grip something and rethinks the handshake
{observer} asks, lightly, whether {subject} scratches

reactions.label: the wings
lines: {observer} stands back to take in {subject}'s wings
{observer} asks whether it hurts to fold them

reactions.label: the horns
lines: {observer} eyes {subject}'s horns and keeps a respectful distance
{observer} asks if they get in the way of hats

reactions.label: the scales
lines: {observer} says {subject} feels different to stand beside, now
{observer} admits the scales take some getting used to

reactions.label: the chitin
lines: {observer} recoils, then leans back in, about {subject}'s shell
"that's a lot of legs," {observer} says, evenly

reactions.label: the feathers
lines: {observer} reaches out to {subject}'s feathers and asks if they are soft
{observer} keeps looking at {subject} like a bird that landed indoors

reactions.label: the new size
lines: {observer} looks at {subject}, recalculating
{observer} jokes that {subject} changed overnight

reactions.label: the new gait
lines: {observer} watches {subject} walk and clocks the strange new rhythm
{observer} asks if {subject}'s legs are alright, in that tone
